title: AgentActivityService
responsibility: Registers agents, records their heartbeats and ends, and lists the agents of a repository with whether each is working now.

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.constructor.root
inputs.description: The checkout path where this service stores its agent registry. It also identifies the unit registry used to mark stated unit IDs as known.

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.constructor.checkouts
inputs.description: The repository checkouts the service considers, each with its path, branch, HEAD SHA or null, and primary flag. A checkout whose path matches root supplies the branch for its initial heartbeat; without a match that branch is null.

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.register.input
inputs.description: Owner-stated registration fields in CLI form; the label is required by this service. The ID allows at most 64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores; text fields are trimmed single lines capped at 120 characters for label, 80 for provider/model/loop, and 200 for task/outcome; units accepts at most 40 comma-separated IDs matching the service unit-ID shape, pid is 1–2147483647, and ttl is 1–86400 seconds (default 900).

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.heartbeat.id
inputs.description: The ID of an agent registration in one of the configured repository checkouts. It must match the service lookup shape of letters, digits, underscores, dots, or dashes and refer to an agent without an end record.

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.heartbeat.input
inputs.description: Owner-stated CLI fields for this heartbeat; supplied fields are validated with the same limits as registration. Only task, loop, and units replace the heartbeat’s prior values, and omitted values among those three keep their previous values.

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.finish.id
inputs.description: The ID of an agent registration in one of the configured repository checkouts. It must match the service lookup shape of letters, digits, underscores, dots, or dashes and refer to an agent without an end record.

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.finish.failed
inputs.description: Whether the end record is marked failed (true) or completed (false).

inputs.name: AgentActivityService.finish.outcome
inputs.description: Optional one-line outcome text saved on the end record after trimming; blank or omitted text is stored as null, and nonblank text is limited to 200 characters. Defaults to undefined.

outputs.name: AgentActivityService.register
outputs.description: The newly stored registration, its initial heartbeat, and end:null. A missing input ID is replaced by randomUUID; omitted provider/model/task/loop become null, units default to an empty array, pid to null, and ttl to 900 seconds.

outputs.name: AgentActivityService.heartbeat
outputs.description: The heartbeat written for the registered agent, timestamped at the call and using its checkout branch. Only supplied task, loop, or units replace their prior values.

outputs.name: AgentActivityService.finish
outputs.description: This operation resolves with no value after writing the first end record, setting its status from failed and storing a trimmed outcome or null. A later finish for that registration throws ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: AgentActivityService.roster
outputs.description: A snapshot across the configured checkouts. Before any registration it returns tracking as never-used, working:null, and an empty roster; otherwise it reports working and unreadable counts and includes working entries plus non-working entries seen within 24 hours. Entries sort by working, stale, gone, failed, then completed, with newer heartbeats first within each state.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The expected CLI validation or lifecycle error. It is thrown for invalid stated fields, a missing registration label, a named PID that is not running, an unknown or ended registration, or a duplicate finish.
